data_description.wrapped_climate: The climate entity to wrap and control
data_description.zone_home: The zone entity used for presence detection
data_description.away_temperature: Target temperature when nobody is home (heating)
data_description.cool_auto_temperature: Target temperature when home and the device is cooling
data_description.cool_away_temperature: Target temperature when away and the device is cooling
data_description.away_delay_minutes: Minutes to wait before applying the away temperature
data_description.interruptible: Whether a presence change can interrupt an active override
data_description.default_override_mode: Override mode used when adjusting temperature (timer, infinity, or next_node)
data_description.default_override_duration: Default duration in minutes for timer override mode
